business_problem: Grupo Boticário needed to support a complex multi-brand reseller and franchise ecosystem across many channels while reducing repetitive operational work and preserving the human relationships that drive sales and service quality.
solution_summary: Grupo Boticário built a proprietary agent orchestration platform to serve a reseller and franchise ecosystem that spans multiple brands, channels, and partner models. The platform combines OpenAI foundation models with business rules so teams can create agents for lead qualification, onboarding, operational support, and response validation without rebuilding each workflow from scratch. Reseller leads arriving through digital channels are qualified by AI, which answers onboarding questions around the clock and transfers prospects to human teams when they are ready to place an order. For ongoing support, the platform handles catalog requests, payment-slip questions, app issues, and other operational topics across appchat and WhatsApp Enterprise. The same system includes validation agents and business-managed prompt iteration, so frontline sales, service, and support teams can A/B test responses and continuously improve automated service quality.

data_flow: A reseller lead or support request enters through a digital channel, appchat, or WhatsApp Enterprise and is routed through the proprietary agent orchestration platform. OpenAI foundation models and business rules qualify leads, answer operational questions, and decide when to hand off to human teams, while validation agents review response quality so updated prompts can be pushed back into the platform for continuous improvement.
business_outcome: Grupo Boticário reached 100% coverage of reseller conversations in appchat and WhatsApp Enterprise, autonomously resolved up to 80% of operational requests, qualified 90% of direct-sales leads with AI, and freed the sales force to focus on advisory relationships instead of repetitive operational work.
